pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit complex, irregular polygonal geometries with notably jagged or stellate edge gradients. Spatial area is non-uniform, with larger, more complex shapes on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more defined shapes on the lower flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative space forms a dense, continuous topological graph. Intersections are primarily tri-valent and tetra-valent nodes. Pathways maintain a relatively narrow pixel thickness with high-frequency directional shifts (crenelated appearance) following the jagged patch edges.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a consistent 1D geometric contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder region.
